map.选择帐篷类型、帐杆材质与帐杆数量，估算帐篷最大抗风风速、蒲福风级与安全露营建议，: Choose tent type, pole material, and pole count to estimate the tent's maximum wind resistance, Beaufort level, and safe-camping advice — a wind-environment reference for outdoor camping.
map.∝ √(E·n) / A（E 帐杆弹性模量，n 杆数，A 迎风面积）: ∝ √(E·n) / A (E = pole elastic modulus, n = pole count, A = windward area)
map.帐篷最大抗风风速随帐杆弹性模量与杆数增加而升高、随迎风面积增大而降低；按帐型(穹: A tent's maximum wind resistance rises with pole elastic modulus and pole count, and falls as windward area grows; estimate the wind level from tent type (dome/tunnel), pole material (aluminum/fiberglass), and pole count, with safe-camping advice.
map.💡 最大抗风风速 = 帐篷基础抗风 × 材质系数 × 帐杆数量系数 × 搭建系数: 💡 Maximum wind resistance = base wind resistance x material coefficient x pole-count coefficient x pitch coefficient, converted to a Beaufort level. Real performance also depends on fabric tension, pegs and guylines, snow skirts, and terrain shelter.
map.超轻帐抗风较弱，三季帐适合常规露营，四季帐/高山帐抗风强: Ultralight tents are weaker against wind; three-season tents suit normal camping; four-season/alpine tents are strong
map.东藻铝(DAC)强度优于普通铝合金，碳纤维轻但受冲击易断: DAC aluminum is stronger than ordinary aluminum alloy; carbon fiber is light but breaks easily on impact
map.帐杆数量越多结构越稳固，抗风能力越强: The more poles, the more stable the structure and the stronger the wind resistance
map.迎风优化(降低迎风面、拉满风绳)可显著提升抗风表现: Wind optimization (lower windward profile, fully tensioned guylines) markedly improves wind performance
map.本估算为经验模型，实际使用请结合厂商数据与现场环境判断: This is an empirical estimate; in practice, combine it with manufacturer data and on-site conditions
map.与 tent-wind-rating 同，防风等级。: Same as tent-wind-rating — wind resistance rating.
map.高山营地按帐型与杆材算抗风系数，选能抗预期风级的帐。: At alpine camps, compute the wind factor from tent type and pole material, and choose a tent that can handle the expected wind level.
map.抗风 8 级（≈17–20 m/s）的高山帐需强地钉与风绳。: An alpine tent rated for Beaufort 8 (≈17-20 m/s) needs strong pegs and guylines.
map.迎风摆放？: How to orient against the wind?
map.帐尾迎风减少受风面。: Point the tail into the wind to reduce the exposed area.
map.抗风系数高就稳？: Is a high wind factor enough for stability?
